1.  select in tokio - Rust - Docs.rs
    The macro aggregates all <async expression> expressions and runs them concurrently on the current task. Once the first expression completes with a value that matches its <pattern>, the select! macro returns the result of evaluating the completed branch's <handler> expression.
    docs.rs/tokio/latest/tokio/macro.select.html
   
2.  Select | Tokio - An asynchronous Rust runtime
    The tokio::select! macro returns the result of the evaluated <handler> expression. ... Because of this, it is required that the <handler> expression for each branch evaluates to the same type.
    tokio.rs/tokio/tutorial/select
